adjacency_rule: The two episodes of a pair run adjacent, in the recorded slot order.
seed_recipe: SHA256("CDEB-FRESH-V8" + task-population-sha + judge-panel-lock-sha + runtime-lock-sha + preregistration-commit-sha), concatenated in that order
what_this_does_not_control: Both arms of a pair still run in sequence on one machine, so anything that drifts with time is shared between them rather than eliminated. Adjacency bounds how much can drift; it does not make the arms independent of when they ran.
